generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document

As per Karnataka State Government order No.LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore Dated 01.01.2007 and Government Letter No.PW/134/BMS/2007 Dated 27.7.2007, a sum amounting to 1%of the bill amount will be deducted towards Construction Labour Welfare fund.
The Item Rate quoted shall include the Royalty Charges on construction materials and other taxes as per prevailing Government Orders
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.
Financial Year will be reckoned as the period between first day of April and Thirty first day of March of succeeding year (both days inclusive).
The Employer reserves the right to reject any or all Tenders without assigning any reason
The Tenderer should maintain the scheme during the defective liability period.
The Department is not responsible for any delay in accessing e-procurement portal.

Tenderer shall note that the Tenders of those found Eligible as mentioned in Clause 3 - Qualification of the Tenderer in Section 2: Instructions to Tenderers (ITT), will only be considered for evaluation.

The Tenderer shall scan & upload all the original documents required for this bid to the e-procurement portal. The Original Documents should be produced at the time of opening of Bid for physical verification.
It is to be noted that any false documentation is found to be uploaded, the action may attract punitive measures such as blacklisting, cancellation of registration etc.
Period of completion mentioned in Bid document.
The contractor should follow terms and conditions as specified in standard bid document KW- 1/2/3/4 whichever is applicable.
Work will be carryout as per the TOR enclosed.
The contractor should submit quality control reports, log book, other registration copies and photos along with the bill otherwise bills will not be accepted.
After opening of Technical bid, eligible bidders work done will be sent to work done verification to concerned authority, more than 5 days for conformation delay of work done will be rejected.
Corrigendums / modifications / correction, if any, will be published in the website only.
Any working staff in this O&M work should be paid minimum labour wages as per act as directed under Govt.
Acceptance / Cancellation of the works are reserved by under signed without any reasons for the same.

All the scanned documents pertaining to bidder to be uploaded shall be in original and same originals should be produced to the Executive Engineer (at the time of Technical Bid Opening) who reserves right to verify the original documents before approval
To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer should give all details and documents as per Technical and Financial bid attached to this tender.
If any date in the tender time table is government holiday, next working date will be considered.
Tenderer must submit his present accurate postal address and phone / cell phone number.

The rates of items are inclusive of cost of materials, labour charges, HOM of machinery, all lead and lifts and all other charges to complete the work successfully as per specifications and as directed by engineer in charge of work.
Any objection regarding the tender must be submitted directly to Executive Engineer, not in inward.
For interpretations of clauses, conditions, spelling mistakes, etc., decision of Executive Engineer, RDW&S, Koppal is final.
Any working staff in this O&M work should be paid minimum labour wages as per act as directed under Govt.
Provide Staff Details in Prescribed format a) Name of Staff b) DOB (DD/MM/YYYY) c) Qualification d)Post of Hired e) Experience of Staff and Bidder

Within 20 days of receipt of the Letter of Acceptance, the successful Tenderer shall deliver to the Employer a Security deposit in any of the forms given below for an amount equivalent to 5% of the Contract price plus additional security for unbalanced tenders in accordance with Clause 25.5 of ITT and Clause 44 of the Conditions of Contract.
The employer reserves the right to accept any tender and to reject any or all tenders without assigning any reason
GST will be paid separately.
All other Conditions mentioned in Bid document.
Tendere Should provide required information in prescribed formats only other than this should not considered as vaild
Vehicle requirements and staff requirements should be according to the Sanctioned Estimate
Unconditional Liquid Assets/Bank Line of Credit from any Nationalized/Scheduled bank, in prescribed formate only, as per government circular order date:-22.08.2022

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: O AND M ESTIMATE FOR 5 YEARS FOR MVSS TO SRIRAMNAGAR AND OTHER 12 VILLAGES IN GANGAVATHI TALUKA OF KOPPAL DISTRICT

itemList.description: Description: Operation and maintenance of the scheme,2025-26 which includes, providing AE/JE: 0 valveman-1, Pump operators-1, Helpers-0, Electrician/Mechanic-0 Watch Man 1 and Plumber 1 and others who are required to run the system in complete manner and providing all materials & chemcials required, for operation of jack wells / WTP 1. Regular maintenance of civil structures like Jackwells / Floating plat form, WTP, PWS, Master balancing tank, pump house and all other civil structures. The maintenance consists of all kinds of repairs to damaged structures, cleaning and washing, o 2. Repairs and replacement of damaged pipe line, valves etc.if found necessary. It includes cost of materials and labour charges and also monitoring of the systems. The maintenance involves raw water rising main, gravity mains, pure water rising mains 3. Operation and maintenance of water treatment plant including dosing of required quantity of alum ,chlorine and other chemicals including replacement of sand / filter media as required as per standard established norms from time to time. Maintaining 4. Operation and maintenance of all kinds of pumping machinery, other mechanical components of this scheme including electrical maintenance covering all repairs / replacement of transformers / Electrical cable / switch board / replacement of burnt parts f All the above repairs & maintenace will be carried out as per the direction of the Engineer-in-charge for satisfactory functioning of the scheme to provide designed LPCD of drinking water to all the habitatants of the Project villages. Note: Helpers / Watchman / Valve man / Technical staff made available round the clock for maintenance period at Jackwell, WTP and Pure water Sump points. 1. The G.P. or VWSC / concerned Section Officer of the Project should certify the satisfactory functioning of the scheme and based on this payments will be made to the contractor 2. The contactor should maintain a Log Book on the working of pumping machinery at Jackwell, WTP etc. II) 2nd year Maintenance complete with all leads & lifts, loading and unloading, labours, materials, hire charges of all machineries & equipments and all incidental charges, etc., complete as directed by the Engineer-in-charge of the work."O AND M ESTIMATE FOR 5 YEARS FOR MVSS TO SRIRAMNAGAR AND OTHER 12 VILLAGES IN GANGAVATHI TALUKA OF KOPPAL DISTRICT (Excluding Energy Charges)
